envelope.description: Make the CLI's stop and restart always end the daemon

body.title: Make the CLI's stop and restart always end the daemon
body.summary: stopDaemon bounds its shutdown request at 5 seconds, waits as today, and after a wait without a stop kills the pid in the pid file, but only when that pid's command line ends in daemon/index.js; it removes the pid file and socket after a kill and returns an outcome with forced and pid. A live pid that does not match is not killed and nothing is removed. A stop with no daemon running still rejects as today. Update the service type and the three callers; restart reports a forced stop and goes on to start. Ordered first with the next Task: neither depends on anything, and they are what helps against the hang as it occurs today.
acceptanceChecks: With an injected process table: forced false when the daemon stops by itself; forced true with the pid after the wait when it does not
A child that accepts the connection and never replies is ended after the 5-second bound and the wait
A child that ignores the request and SIGTERM is ended, and its pid file and socket are removed
A live pid whose command line does not end in daemon/index.js is not killed, its pid file is kept, and the stop fails naming it
With no socket and no live pid the stop rejects with 'daemon is not running'
restart's steps include 'force-stop' after a forced stop and the start follows

tests.name: stop outcome with an injected process table: stops by itself, forced after the wait, pid not a daemon, pid survives the kill
stop outcome: no socket and no live pid rejects with 'daemon is not running'
stop outcome: a live pid whose command line does not match is not killed and its pid file is kept
forced stop: a child that ignores the request and SIGTERM is ended by stopDaemon
forced stop, silent daemon: a child that accepts the connection and never replies is ended
